subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He suddenly tried to __throw cold water__ on my plans.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To discourage. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"to throw cold water on"** means to discourage a plan or idea, or to present reasons why it cannot succeed. (उत्साह को ठंडा करना) • **Example: **His negative comments threw cold water on our enthusiasm for the project. • **"To discourage" **refers to making someone less confident or enthusiastic about something. (हतोत्साहित करना) • **Example: **She discouraged him from taking the risky investment. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To seize the opportunity **(मौके का फायदा उठाना): To take advantage of a situation or chance. • **Example:** He seized the opportunity to travel when he got a job offer abroad. • **To understand the hidden meaning **(छिपे हुए अर्थ को समझना): To grasp the underlying or implicit message. • **Example: **It took him a while to understand the hidden meaning behind her words. • **To take revenge** (बदला लेना): To retaliate or get back at someone for a wrongdoing. • **Example:** He vowed to take revenge on those who had wronged him. 32:Ta28, The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
